# gatekeep-pr #42: run-record updates and menus

Tracker init: `gather, provision, verify`. There is no `--rebase`, so no `Sync:` line renders and no `sync` stage exists. Verification and the brief assess `1111111111111111111111111111111111111111` (source: ci).

## Main sequence: initial menu

```text
gauntlet: gate=gatekeep-pr/initial recommended=2
Delivers: the PR rejects unsigned events.
Role: author

Blockers:
1. The guard accepts an empty signature, so an event with no signature passes as signed. (src/guard.mjs:8)

Verdict: fixable - 1 blocker

Pick one:
1. assess - post the review to the PR; then approve or stop, no repairs.
2. deliver - repair blockers, rebase on main, watch CI, repeat until merge is offered. [recommended]
3. stop - remove the worktree, leave the PR as is.

Not offered: deliver with nits (no nits).
Course holds until the final menu; `show evidence` prints the full record.
```

The human picks `2`. The course is set to deliver, and the caps and usage are persisted before any write.

anthropic/claude-opus-5-5.feedback: No fact moved on this case: After keeps the single numeric `2` as the only deliver start, repairs P1 and the CI-minted P2 with closure review and no intermediate menu, renews poll_deadline only on own pushes (12:17, 12:25, 12:27) while explicitly marking the 12:11 base move as 'not renewed', queues the BEHIND sync without a decision, offers merge on final without executing anything until the human picks, exits B as stuck on base-only movement, admits exactly one watch in C with 0/10 rounds, and in D leases against A, keeps A unreplaced, and restores B via reset --hard with no retry. The Change (sequencing batch-summary menus and exercising no-arg discovery / role lines) is not visible in this single-PR argument case beyond the added `Role: author` line, which is harmless. Two small regressions worth tightening so later cases don't slip: After's D table no longer states that pre_head/expected_remote_head were persisted *before* the rebase (Before had an explicit 'Before sync (persisted)' row) — keep a step-ordered row or add 'persisted before rebase' to the field labels; and After drops the 'Not offered: approve (your own PR)' line from both final menus and invents 'rounds 1/10' in D where the case gives no usage, so retain the not-offered approve line for own PRs and only report usage values the case supplies.

github-copilot/gpt-6.1-sol.feedback: The After wording did not move any fact on this case: the main sequence still records a single numeric `2`, two helper repairs with no intermediate menu, BEHIND-driven sync, a final menu that offers merge and executes nothing on `2`, and checkpoints B, C and D keep the repeated-red exit, the single authorized re-run watch, and the pre_head B / expected_remote_head A lease-and-restore story. The one fact that fails in both outputs is f2, and it fails for the same reason in each: the 12:02 own push is recorded with deadline `null` ("no watch has started, so there is no deadline to renew") rather than 12:17, so the table never shows the 12:02→12:17 renewal the fact requires even though 12:10→12:25 and 12:12→12:27 are present and the 12:11 base-only observation is correctly shown as non-renewing. To keep every fact Before kept and satisfy f2 while still delivering the per-PR sequential batch-summary change, have the own-push row set the watch deadline at every own push (12:02→12:17, 12:10→12:25, 12:12→12:27) regardless of whether a watch was previously admitted, keep the explicit "observation only, not an own push, no renewal" note on the base-move row, and retain the `Not offered: approve (own PR)` line in the final menu so the no-approval branch of f3 stays visible rather than implied.
